sloka: भरतश्च सशत्रुघ्नश्चीरवासा वनेचरः ।वने वसन्तम् काकुत्थ्समनुवत्स्यति पूर्वजम् ॥२-३७-२७॥
transliteration: bharataśca saśatrughnaścīravāsā vanecaraḥ ।vane vasantam kākutthsamanuvatsyati pūrvajam ॥2-37-27॥

translations.english: Wandering in the forest and wearing bark, Satrughna and Bharata will live in the company of their elder brother (Rama) in the jungle.
